2026_03_NE_JAX.headline: Maye meets Jacksonville with protection, takeaways and field position in focus
2026_03_NE_JAX.paragraph1: Drake Maye brings New England to Jacksonville after the Patriots opened 1-1 behind a defense allowing eight points per game, while Trevor Lawrence and the Jaguars enter 1-1 with a positive turnover margin. New England has allowed six sacks, making protection central against Jacksonville’s front, while Liam Coen needs Lawrence to sustain drives against a Patriots pass defense allowing 166 yards per game. Jacksonville also enters with Jakobi Meyers practicing fully despite a thumb issue.
2026_03_NE_JAX.model_rationale: New England’s defensive start raises the cost of Jacksonville turnovers, while the Patriots’ protection must hold up well enough for Maye to avoid handing the Jaguars short fields.
